cs.t: I remember my time using an Alpha AXP nearly 30 years ago being the fastest computer I've ever used - I imagine my current laptop is far superior in speed by orders of magnitude, but the applications hadn't caught up with the CPU available. It was also probably the most reliable.  We never switched off or even logged out of the machines for 6 months to a year at a time.
cs.th: Long gone, DEC is still powering the world of computing
